Why PlayStation?
PlayStation isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. The PlayStation brand falls under Sony Interactive Entertainment, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.
■組織・職場紹介
PS5、PS4をはじめ、歴代PlayStationのシステムソフトウェア開発を担う組織です。
本ポジションの配属先では、主にゲームのダウンロード、インストール、アップデート、起動に関わる一連の機能を担当します。
扱うのは、単なるアプリケーション開発ではなく、大容量コンテンツをいかに早く・確実に・互換性を保って届けるかという、PlayStationにおけるゲームプレイ体験の中核を支える領域です。数十GB〜100GB超のゲームコンテンツを、ネットワーク帯域、ストレージ容量、実行環境、過去資産との互換性といった複数の制約の中で最適に扱うための、幅広い視点での設計力と実装力が求められます。
東京拠点だけでなく、米国拠点の開発・運用チームや関連チームと連携しながら開発を進める、グローバルな職場です。また、ゲーム開発者や外部パートナーと協働しながら、ゲームタイトルとSDK、システムソフトウェアやインフラとの依存関係を踏まえた設計・改善にも取り組みます。
PlayStationのシステムソフトウェアは多数のモジュールで構成されており、関連モジュールの専門チームと密に連携しながら、課題の洗い出し、解決方針の検討、実装までを進めます。
1億以上の月間アクティブユーザのゲーム体験を支える基盤技術に携わり、将来世代も見据えた設計・開発に挑戦できる環境です。
■職務内容
・PlayStationシステムソフトウェアにおける、ゲーム配信・インストール・アップデートに関わるクライアントソフトウェアの設計・開発を担当します。
・ゲームタイトルとシステムソフトウェア、SDKの依存関係や、既存タイトル資産・将来タイトル双方の制約を踏まえ、長期的な互換性と運用を見据えた設計を行います。
・新規要件や機能追加に対して、ソリューション検討、基本設計、関連チームとの仕様調整・合意形成を担います。
・チームメンバーや協力会社メンバーと連携し、詳細設計、実装、単体・結合テスト、リリース後のサポートまで一貫して担当します。
・ご経験に応じて、チームリードまたはチームリード候補として、設計方針の推進やチーム横断での課題解決を担っていただくことを期待しています。
■ダウンロード・インストール機能について
・100GBを超えるゲームについても、可能な限り早くプレイ可能な状態に到達させるためのダウンロード・インストール機能を開発しています。
・言語や対象PlayStationの性能特性に応じてゲームバイナリを分割し、ユーザ操作やシステム状態に応じてダウンロード対象や順序を最適化することで、効率的な配信を実現しています。
・アップデート時には差分のみをダウンロードし、再利用可能なデータは既存インストール済みデータを活用することで、高速かつ効率的な更新を実現しています。
・あわせて、ゲームタイトルをコンソールのライフサイクル全体で、継続的に安定して動作させるため、ランタイム環境のアップデートや構成管理にも取り組みます。
■求める 実務経験・スキル
【必須要件（MUST）】
・C++によるソフトウェア開発経験、またはオペレーティングシステム／ミドルウェアなど低レイヤ領域の開発経験（5年以上）

【歓迎要件（WANT）】

・CI/CDパイプライン、プロダクトのビルドシステム構築、またはQA業務の経験
・Python、JavaScriptなどのスクリプト言語の知識
・デザインパターンを活用したソフトウェア設計経験
・SDK開発経験
・テストプログラム、テストフレームワーク、またはテストインフラの設計・開発・運用経験
・PlayStation固有の知識は入社時点では必須ではなく、必要に応じてキャッチアップしていただきます
【語学力】

jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. We're looking for a Sr. Lab Engineer to own the test lab that supports our solar array development team. This isn't a device-physics role — it's a lab operations role for someone who has spent years running precision test equipment, keeping data clean and traceable, and being the person a team of scientists and engineers trusts to get a test set up right, run it correctly, and know when something looks off. Your primary customers will be senior solar scientists. You'll work with them, translating their test needs into well-run, well-documented lab operations, and giving them direct feedback on test setups, fixturing, and equipment capability. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities • Own the day-to-day operation of the photovoltaic test lab, including equipment calibration schedules, preventive maintenance, and lab readiness for solar cell and module test campaigns • Partner directly with senior solar scientists to scope test requirements, then design and execute the test setups, fixturing, and data collection methods that meet those requirements • Provide direct technical feedback on proposed test setups and equipment choices, drawing on hands-on experience to flag issues before they cost the team time • Manage and prioritize concurrent test requests across multiple scientists and programs, communicating status, risk, and trade-offs clearly • Own data integrity and traceability for all test outputs — consistent formatting, version control, calibration records, and documentation that others can pick up and trust • Troubleshoot equipment and test setup issues at the root cause, working with vendors when equipment service is required • Develop and maintain test procedures, work instructions, and lab documentation; train other lab staff on equipment and methods • Drive lab-wide process improvements (layout, tooling tracking, calibration systems) and mentor other lab engineers A day in the life As a Sr. Lab Engineer, you'll split your time between hands-on equipment operation and coordinating with the scientists who rely on your lab. You might start the morning checking a solar simulator's calibration ahead of a test run, then sit down with a senior scientist to scope a new test fixture for an upcoming module characterization. Mid-day could involve troubleshooting a data acquisition issue on an environmental chamber, or reviewing test data with a colleague to make sure it's clean and properly logged before it feeds into someone else's analysis. You'll be the steady hand that keeps test campaigns moving accurately and on schedule, even as priorities shift. About the team The Amazon Leo Development Operations (DevOps) team supports the Satellite Vehicle Engineering organization's solar array development effort, providing the lab infrastructure, equipment, and test execution that our solar scientists depend on. The team supports multiple concurrent programs spanning production satellites, next-generation module development, and advanced solar cell R&D. Priorities shift quickly, and you'll take on new responsibilities as needed to keep the lab running and the team successful.

jobs.description: At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference. Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact. We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together. Job Description O(a) Territory Specialist (TS) será responsável por promover os produtos da companhia relacionados ao tratamento e/ou prevenção do HIV, desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com profissionais de saúde, instituições e contas-chave em seu território de atuação. Atua como principal representante comercial da empresa, combinando conhecimento científico e excelência em vendas para impulsionar resultados, ampliar o acesso aos tratamentos e apoiar a adoção adequada das terapias. É responsável pelo planejamento e execução da estratégia territorial, gestão de stakeholders, identificação de oportunidades de mercado e colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para atingir os objetivos de negócio, sempre em conformidade com os padrões éticos e regulatórios da indústria farmacêutica. Conhecimentos e Competências Excelentes habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal, construção de parcerias e influência junto a diferentes públicos. Capacidade comprovada de negociação e gestão de stakeholders. Conhecimento sólido da área terapêutica, doença e portfólio de produtos relacionados à sua atuação. Conhecimento do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) e dos fluxos administrativos e assistenciais relacionados à área terapêutica. Familiaridade com tendências do mercado farmacêutico, cenário competitivo e estratégias dos principais concorrentes. Capacidade de discutir protocolos terapêuticos considerando aspectos como eficácia, segurança, custo, posologia e duração do tratamento. Visão analítica para identificar oportunidades, desafios e tendências emergentes, elaborando recomendações para as áreas de Vendas e Marketing. Habilidade para analisar problemas de complexidade moderada, interpretar informações relevantes e propor soluções adequadas. Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa em equipes multifuncionais (cross-functional). Perfil proativo, orientado para resultados, com elevado nível de autonomia e autogerenciamento. Formação e Experiência Requisitos Obrigatórios Graduação completa (Bacharelado ou Licenciatura) em áreas relevantes. Diferenciais Experiência prévia na área terapêutica relacionada à posição. Conhecimento do ambiente hospitalar, instituições de saúde e contas estratégicas da região Participação em lançamentos de produtos ou novas indicações terapêuticas. Principais Responsabilidades Alcançar de forma consistente as metas de cobertura, frequência de visitas e resultados de vendas no território sob sua responsabilidade. Representar os produtos e serviços da empresa junto aos profissionais de saúde e principais contas estratégicas. Promover o uso adequado dos produtos por meio de conhecimento científico e técnico da área terapêutica. Desenvolver e executar o plano de negócios do território, definindo prioridades e ações para atingir os objetivos estabelecidos. Monitorar a evolução dos resultados comerciais, implementando planos de ação e acompanhando indicadores de desempenho. Gerenciar o orçamento do território, incluindo investimentos em eventos científicos, reuniões com clientes e demais atividades promocionais aprovadas. Atuar em parceria com equipes internas, incluindo Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs), Marketing, Acesso, Contas Estratégicas e demais áreas da organização. Identificar oportunidades e barreiras de mercado, comunicando recomendações e insights para as lideranças de Marketing e Vendas. Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico e comercial de colegas e equipes regionais, participando de treinamentos e compartilhamento de melhores práticas. Construir e expandir relacionamentos estratégicos com médicos, instituições e demais stakeholders relevantes. Participar de congressos, eventos científicos e atividades profissionais representando a empresa. Realizar atividades administrativas relacionadas à função, incluindo atualização de sistemas, gestão de despesas e registro de interações com clientes. Garantir conformidade com as políticas internas da companhia, códigos de conduta e todas as regulamentações aplicáveis ao setor farmacêutico. Perfil de Sucesso Buscamos profissionais com forte orientação para resultados, elevada capacidade de execução, mentalidade estratégica, foco no cliente e habilidade para influenciar decisões em ambientes complexos. O candidato ideal combina conhecimento científico, excelência comercial e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa para gerar impacto sustentável nos negócios e nos pacientes. Na Gilead, estamos criando um mundo mais saudável para todas as pessoas. Há mais de 35 anos, enfrentamos doenças como HIV, hepatites virais, COVID-19 e câncer, trabalhando incansavelmente para desenvolver terapias que ajudem a melhorar vidas e garantir o acesso a esses tratamentos em todo o mundo. Continuamos a lutar contra alguns dos maiores desafios de saúde global, e nossa missão exige colaboração, determinação e um compromisso contínuo em gerar impacto positivo. Cada integrante da equipe da Gilead desempenha um papel fundamental na descoberta e no desenvolvimento de inovações científicas capazes de transformar vidas. Nossos colaboradores são nosso maior patrimônio na busca por objetivos ambiciosos, e estamos sempre em busca de pessoas apaixonadas, talentosas e determinadas, prontas para causar um impacto direto na vida dos pacientes. Acreditamos que todo colaborador merece uma liderança inspiradora. Os líderes de pessoas são a base da experiência dos colaboradores na Gilead e na Kite. Como líder atual ou futuro, você terá um papel fundamental na evolução da nossa cultura e na criação de um ambiente onde todos se sintam incluídos, desenvolvidos e capacitados para alcançar suas aspirações profissionais. Junte-se à Gilead e ajude-nos a tornar o impossível possível, juntos. For Current Gilead Employees and Contractors: Please apply via the Internal Career Opportunities portal in Workday.

jobs.description: This is the role where architecture meets impact. The Account Solutions Architect (SA) is the trusted technical advisor that customers rely on from first engagement through production and beyond - building sustained technical relationships, understanding customer objectives, and guiding them toward solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. Through ongoing technical credibility and a commitment to the customer's success, the Account SA drives adoption and deepens engagement in ways that produce lasting business outcomes as the enduring technical voice that earns and maintains customer trust as a member of the account team. The SA validates recommendations through hands-on building, turning architectural insight into working solutions that earn customer trust. The Account SA provides prescriptive technical guidance - selecting services, designing secure, resilient and scalable architectures, optimizing for cost and performance, and surfacing risks early. Operates as a hands-on builder in the customer's [non-production] environment, validating solutions through working proof points (PoCs, prototypes, reference implementations) because working solutions earn trust that documents cannot. The role scales impact beyond individual engagements by contributing reusable assets other practitioners adopt, orchestrating access to deeper expertise when needed, and transferring capability so customers achieve self-sufficiency rather than dependency. Key job responsibilities Technical Solution Design & Customer Advisory • Designs end-to-end solutions for customer workloads, making trade-off decisions across security, scalability, reliability, performance, cost, and operational efficiency while navigating constraints, operational maturity, and competing business priorities. • Acts as a trusted technical advisor to the customer's technical and business stakeholders, understanding business objectives, technology landscape, and industry context to recommend fit-for-purpose solutions that connect architectural decisions to long-term business outcomes. • Advances customer decisions across complex stakeholder groups by making business outcomes (cost reduction, time-to-value, return on investment) tangible and credible through the appropriate combination of architectural reasoning, technical proof, or working demonstrations. • Evaluates existing customer architectures to identify gaps, risks, modernization and optimization opportunities; delivers actionable remediation guidance and modernization roadmaps. Building & Demonstrating Solutions • Operates as a hands-on builder who develops and validates solutions through working proof points in own sandbox and customer non-production environments - leveraging emerging technologies and AI-assisted development to accelerate proof-of-value delivery while maintaining security and operational rigor. • Applies a production mindset from the outset, integrating governance, security, resiliency, observability, and human validation of critical deliverables into all demonstrable artifacts. Delivers solutions to Amazon Coding Bar (technical standards): tested, secure, and maintainable by others. Cross-Functional Collaboration • Partners with sales, business development, professional services, support, product/engineering teams, and external partners teams to move solutions from adoption through launch, orchestrating multi-team delivery against a shared architecture. • Provides technical input to product teams by translating customer evidence into clear, actionable requirements that tighten the feedback loop between Account engagements and product direction. Enablement & Organizational Development • Improves how the team operates by driving process changes, knowledge transfer, mentoring others, leading design reviews, creating reusable assets (code, tooling, reference implementations) that scale best practices, and recruiting technical talent to sustain a high-performing team. Thought Leadership & Content Development • Develops and delivers prescriptive technical content - reference architectures, workshops, white papers, blog posts, and presentations - that shifts how other technical practitioners deliver and educates the broader technical community. • Represents the organization at industry events, customer forums, and technical conferences as a recognized technical voice. A day in the life Your day starts with context - reviewing where your customers are in their technical journey, what's changed in their environment, and what's next. You might open with a design session where you're whiteboarding architecture options with a customer's engineering team, making trade-off decisions together, and committing to a direction. By mid-morning, you're building - writing code, deploying infrastructure, or extending a proof of concept in a sandbox to validate what you recommended yesterday. After lunch, you're in a customer strategy session with your account team - advising on technical direction, connecting technical progress to business outcomes, navigating competing priorities, and aligning on what proof point will give the customer's decision-makers confidence to move forward. Not everything is clear-cut; you often work with incomplete information, shifting requirements, and stakeholders who don't yet agree on the problem - and you move things forward anyway. Your week includes time you protect for keeping current - whether that's tracking emerging technologies, following industry shifts, or getting hands-on with a new service before a customer asks about it. You invest in the broader SA community too: mentoring a newer SA through a complex engagement or publishing a reference architecture from a recent win so others don't start from scratch. Travel is part of the rhythm - you're on-site with customers as the role requires, varying by geography and customer portfolio, because trust is built faster in person and the best architectural decisions happen at the whiteboard, not over email.
